newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tubacex Q1 net profit rises 24.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: Tubacex Q1 net profit rises 24.6 percent.

text.p: Spanish steel group Tubacex on Monday posted net consolidated profit of 885 million pesetas in the first quarter of 1997, a 24.6 percent increase on the previous year.
In a statement, the company said consolidated sales fell 23 percent to 6.04 billion pesetas. The fall was largely due to the transport strike and the Easter holidays, the company said.
Net cashflow rose 19.3 percent to 1.23 billion pesetas.

Tubacex said orders at the end of the first quarter and the start of the second were "considerably higher". This was affecting sale prices, and the company forecast that 1997 results should rise from 1996 earnings of 3.12 billion pesetas.
